title: Who handles each part
sub: One connected account, with a distinct role for each participant.
note: Stripe determines capability availability. Clientbridge keeps the owner informed.

title: Different states, different next steps
sub: Examples an owner can encounter; these are not a fixed sequence.
note: Read requirements, card payments and payouts separately. Readiness can change.

title: Refresh the account behind the status
sub: Notifications, owner refresh and recovery can all trigger the read.
note: The local record is a mirror. A later payment request still depends on Stripe’s current state.
